intro: Speak with Anastasia is an introductory summons directing promising Forsaken mages to Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity. Dispatched by mage trainer Cain Firesong, the young caster is called to the Magic Quarter to undertake critical work for the magi of the Forsaken. This brief summons sets the stage for investigations out into the blighted lands of Tirisfal Glades.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents. Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, friend. You were wise to answer my call, and wiser still if you heed what I next say...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
